name: Bounded repair and escalation
userOutcome: The user can allow autonomous repair within explicit limits and receive a complete escalation package when repair is unsafe or exhausted.
productionDataSource: Failed evidence, failure classification, repair policy, previous attempts, budgets, and repository state.
errorBehavior: Preserve attempts and failing artifacts, avoid changing scope silently, stop at limits, and present options and impact.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not modify acceptance criteria during repair.
Do not hide failed attempts or cost.
acceptanceTests: Create an escalation with evidence and recommendation.
